assets.sourceTitle: An espresso machine sitting on top of a counter
assets.licenseEvidence: Primary photo page explicitly marks this photograph free to use under the Unsplash License.
assets.altText: A polished espresso machine with glasses warming above a cup of coffee.
assets.appearance: Portrait frame; charcoal and polished silver with muted warm reflections. No people or added text/watermark. A small machine emblem is visible on the left knob.
assets.location: Not specified on inspected source page; do not label as Oman.

cropSuggestions.preferred: 4:5 portrait or square; retain the central brew head and glass below.
cropSuggestions.wideCard: A 16:9 crop centered near 50% 65% emphasizes the brew head, portafilter, and coffee. Check the cup remains visible.
cropSuggestions.avoid: Avoid a top-only crop that shows just the warming glasses. Keep any overlay text in the UI outside the photograph.

assets.sourceTitle: Person making clay pot on white round plate
assets.licenseEvidence: Primary photo page explicitly marks this photograph free to use under the Unsplash License.
assets.altText: Clay-covered hands shape a ceramic cup on a spinning pottery wheel.
assets.appearance: Landscape frame; neutral clay, silver wheel, charcoal edges. Hands only, no face, no visible lettering, no watermark.
assets.location: Santa Barbara, California, USA, as stated by the photographer. Do not label as Oman.

cropSuggestions.preferred: 3:2 landscape or 16:9; preserve the cup rim and working fingers.
cropSuggestions.squareCard: Center crop around the cup and hands; the outer wheel can fall outside the frame.
cropSuggestions.avoid: Avoid cropping away the fingertips or the cup rim, which explain the making activity.

assets.altText: Architectural drawings and drafting tools spread across a planning desk.
assets.appearance: Landscape frame; muted charcoal, grey-blue, and aged neutral paper. No people or added text/watermark. The paper contains intrinsic drafting annotations.
assets.location: Not specified on inspected source page; do not label as Oman.

cropSuggestions.preferred: 3:2 or 16:9 landscape; retain the dark arc tool in the foreground.
cropSuggestions.squareCard: Center slightly low to keep the drafting arc and detailed paper; allow empty background to crop away.
cropSuggestions.avoid: Avoid cropping to only the blurred upper wall; the tools and plans carry the planning meaning.
